comparison.objective: Fasten an instrument case using separate spring hooks, lever tension, and independent safety catches.
comparison.physical_skill: Choose keepers, engage loose hooks, tension levers, and set secondary catches while preserving instrument orientation.
comparison.success_condition: Case remains fastened for 20 seconds hands-off with cases and instruments upright. Detailed tolerances are absent from the available body.
comparison.reason: Both include locking and hands-off retention, but this record tests multi-latch closure; the candidate uniquely tests hex-key unlocking, continuous collar tuning, torque control, and measured dynamic response.
